company.shortDescription: Sapiom enables organizations to deploy, govern, and orchestrate AI agents across models, tools, compute resources, and external services.
company.description:
Sapiom develops an artificial intelligence agent management platform that enables organizations to deploy, govern, and orchestrate AI agents across models, tools, compute resources, and external services. The company's platform dynamically selects execution paths based on task requirements, cost, latency, quality, reliability, organizational policies, and available infrastructure while enforcing governance, budgets, and access permissions before execution. It provides agent orchestration, policy management, identity and access controls, observability, workflow automation, developer tools, and integrations with large language models, APIs, cloud services, and enterprise applications.

Sapiom also supports agent lifecycle management, resource optimization, payment orchestration, and secure access to external services, allowing AI agents to autonomously perform tasks within defined operational and financial controls. The company's platform is designed to help enterprises build, manage, and scale production AI agents through centralized governance, intelligent routing, and automated execution across heterogeneous AI and cloud environments.
